english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when endurance means sustained physical effort.
Use this when emphasizing the ability to keep exerting yourself or withstand difficulty for a long time.

examples.english: Running a marathon tests your endurance the most.
examples.jyutping: paau2 maa5 laai1 cung4 zeoi3 haau2 jim6 noi6 lik6

examples.english: This mountain trail is so long; it really tests your stamina.
examples.traditional: 呢條山路咁長，真係好考耐力。
